classification.difficultyReason: Infer the concave shape's two unlabelled sides from horizontal and vertical differences, then simplify its perimeter and use it in an equation; the earlier rectangle parts provide useful scaffolding.

inlines.text: All side lengths are in centimetres.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Write an expression to find the perimeter of the shape. Simplify the expression.

spec.description: Unfilled orthogonal L-shaped outline with the lower-left corner removed. Labels are 3x + 5 above the full top edge, 4x + 2 left of the short left edge, 7x + 2 right of the full right edge and 2x + 4 below the short bottom edge. Both inward edges are unlabelled. All six vertices have small black structural markers.
spec.mathematics: The inward horizontal length is (3x + 5) - (2x + 4); the inward vertical length is (7x + 2) - (4x + 2). These derived expressions are withheld from the question diagram. Drawing coordinates describe the schematic silhouette, not extra numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: The two missing side expressions and the perimeter answer are solution-only.

answer.worked:
The inward horizontal and vertical lengths are:
$$\begin{align*}h&=(3x+5)-(2x+4)\\h&=x+1\\v&=(7x+2)-(4x+2)\\v&=3x\end{align*}$$
Hence
$$\begin{align*}P&=(3x+5)+(7x+2)+(2x+4)+3x+(x+1)+(4x+2)\\P&=20x+14\end{align*}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: Determine the value of $x$ if the perimeter is $64\text{ cm}$.

spec.description: Unfilled orthogonal L-shaped outline with the lower-left corner removed. Labels are 3x + 5 above the full top edge, 4x + 2 left of the short left edge, 7x + 2 right of the full right edge and 2x + 4 below the short bottom edge. Both inward edges are unlabelled. All six vertices have small black structural markers.
spec.mathematics: The inward horizontal length is (3x + 5) - (2x + 4); the inward vertical length is (7x + 2) - (4x + 2). The perimeter simplifies to 20x + 14. Drawing coordinates describe the schematic silhouette, not extra numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: Missing side expressions, the perimeter equation and the solved value of x are solution-only.

answer.worked:
The missing sides are $x+1$ and $3x$, so the perimeter is $20x+14$.
$$\begin{align*}20x+14&=64\\20x&=50\\x&=2.5\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
Check: $20(2.5)+14=64\text{ cm}$.
